POICapabilities.name: POI Capabilities
POICapabilities.definition: Capabilities of the POI (Point Of Interaction) performing the status report.

POIComponent.name: POI Component
POIComponent.definition: Data related to a component of the POI (Point Of Interaction) performing the status report.

POIGroupIdentification.name: POI Group Identification
POIGroupIdentification.definition: Identifier assigned to a set of POI terminals performing some categories of transactions.

AttendanceContext.name: Attendance Context
AttendanceContext.definition: Human attendance at the POI (Point Of Interaction) location during transactions.

POIDateTime.name: POI Date Time
POIDateTime.definition: System date time of the point of interaction (POI) sending the status report.

DataSetRequired.name: Data Set Required
DataSetRequired.definition: Request the terminal management system to answer with the identified data set.

Event.name: Event
Event.definition: Result of an individual terminal management action by the point of interaction.

Errors.name: Errors
Errors.definition: Error log of the point of interaction since the last status report.
